verdict.rationale: SvelteKit server-renders routes by default and documents a first-party `adapter-vercel`, which also supports ISR, so deploying to a serverless platform is implied. A community user also reports running SvelteKit happily on Netlify. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the adapter system for serverless deployment, any evidence of edge-runtime support (e.g. Cloudflare or Vercel Edge), adapters for other platforms, and hands-on corroboration of zero-config deploys.
